# Independent C-STAT methods validation

**PASS (confirmatory)**: 6,000 complete independent logs, 1,134,000 candidate records, 84 cell/method/level summaries, exactly 17 primary Holm comparisons. No outcomes generated by this script.

All 28,884,898 checks passed. The independent aggregation matches every field of the frozen summary (discrete fields exactly, floating fields to relative 5e-12 / absolute 5e-13).

Checkpoint payload/input hashes, exact assigned IDs, seed streams, candidate families, paired observations, expected statuses, analytic truth, support intersections, coverage, errors and decisions were independently checked. Empty confidence intersections remain coverage failures. Point-only and F graph-inapplicable records have no fabricated intervals.

Primary uncertainty uses one whole log per family. Marginal candidate fractions are separately reported; they are not independent-log power estimates. Holm uses exactly the registered 17 tests; 90% diagnostics remain secondary. Nonrejection does not prove validity.

Additional family-level any-false-certification and any-detection events, Wilson descriptive uncertainty, candidate fractions, raw/support widths and error/radius quantiles are in `family_decisions_and_widths.csv`.

Regeneration: `.venv/bin/python reports/gate_C_stat_audit/validate_confirmatory.py --input results/gate_C/confirmatory --output results/gate_C/confirmatory/independent_validation --phase confirmatory --figures`

Source provenance: the canonical manifest pins scientific source/config/seed/launcher digests; `final_preservation_check.json` checks all old files. The independent validator imports neither estimators nor the production summarizer. It uses exact integer/rational binomial formulas and independent Wilson/Holm/coverage/width/decision recomputation. Its floating summary comparison uses the saved declared tolerance; the separate prelaunch scientific-output comparison was bytewise.
